title: Subscription Line Item
description: A line item that recurs under a subscription: the item, its quantity, and the purchase option stating the terms currently in effect.

id.description: Line item identifier, unique within the subscription. It identifies the subscription line, not an Order line.

item.description: The item that recurs, including identity, price, and sale basis. Its `price` is the unit price recurring orders are currently placed at.

quantity.description: Quantity placed in each recurring order, as an integer step count of the item's `quantity_unit`. When `item.quantity_unit` is absent, it counts whole items.

purchase_option.description: The purchase option the line recurs on, stating the terms currently in effect. Its `price` is the line's `item.price`; its `schedules` state the recurring orders for the line at its quantity, starting with the schedule in effect. Its `id` need not resolve through the catalog.
